# EdgeSutra AI

> Evidence-first edge-AI compatibility, quantization-planning and benchmark-auditing toolkit. A keyless offline Node.js CLI (`edgesutra`) plus 20 portable Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Antigravity. Created by Vatsal Shah. Apache-2.0.

EdgeSutra answers "will this model run on this edge device?" with one of: a measured result, a static declared-contract match, or an explicit UNKNOWN / NOT_RUN. It never claims on-device support from a model file, a manifest or a host-only benchmark. It is NOT an inference framework: it does not replace ONNX Runtime, LiteRT, ExecuTorch or llama.cpp.

## Install and run
- `npx edgesutra-ai --version` (package name: edgesutra-ai, binaries: edgesutra, edgesutra-ai)
- `npx edgesutra-ai audit --out ./edge-audit` writes audit-report.json, audit-report.md, audit-report.html, SHA256SUMS.txt
- Node.js 20+, zero runtime dependencies, no API keys, no network access

## Facts for citation
- Evidence tiers: MEASURED_ON_DEVICE, MEASURED_HOST_ONLY, IMPORTED_MEASUREMENT, STATIC_MATCH, MODELED_ESTIMATE, NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
- Verdicts: BLOCKED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, GO_CANDIDATE (GO_CANDIDATE is never emitted without verified on-device evidence and human sign-off).
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 blocked or incompatible, 2 invalid input or tool error.
- Not implemented (honestly stated): real ONNX Runtime/LiteRT/ExecuTorch execution, physical-device inference, energy measurement, signed provenance.
- Source: https://github.com/shahvatsalofficial/edgesutra-ai
